name: Response Evaluators
description: Pluggable evaluator implementations behind an Evaluator protocol (@runtime_checkable typing.Protocol). Each evaluator takes a local TaskResponse and a remote TaskResponse (ground truth) plus task-specific evaluator config, and returns a frozen EvaluationResult (score 0.0–1.0, per-field breakdown, evaluator type used, optional error, metadata, timestamp). Built-in implementations: StructuredMatchEvaluator (per-field exact match rate averaged across configured match_fields), ExactMatchEvaluator (full output equality yielding 0.0 or 1.0), SemanticSimilarityEvaluator (cosine similarity of embeddings with lazy-loaded sentence-transformers model and injectable embed_fn). Custom evaluator support via Pydantic ImportString resolved at config parse time, wrapped in FunctionEvaluatorAdapter. All evaluators are stateless, independently testable, and clamp scores to [0.0, 1.0]. Runtime errors never raise — they produce EvaluationResult with score=0.0 and error annotation. Config errors fail fast via Pydantic validation at startup.

types.name: EvaluatorType
types.description: Enumeration of supported evaluator type identifiers. Used in TaskEvaluatorConfig and logged in EvaluationResult for audit filtering.

types.name: TaskResponse

fields.name: task_id
fields.description: Unique identifier of the task this response belongs to.

fields.name: output
fields.description: The full textual output of the model for this task.

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Structured key-value fields extracted from the output. Keys are field names (str), values are the field values (any JSON-serializable type). Used by StructuredMatchEvaluator for per-field comparison.

fields.name: model_id
fields.description: Identifier of the model that produced this response. Empty string if unknown.

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: ISO-8601 datetime string of when this response was generated.

types.description: A task response (either local model output or remote ground truth) to be evaluated. Carries the full output string and an optional structured fields dict for per-field comparison. This is a Pydantic BaseModel.

types.name: TaskEvaluatorConfig

fields.name: evaluator_type
fields.description: Which evaluator implementation to use for this task.

fields.name: match_fields
fields.description: List of field names to compare for StructuredMatchEvaluator. Must be non-empty when evaluator_type is 'structured_match'. Validated at config parse time.

validators.error_message: match_fields must be non-empty when evaluator_type is 'structured_match'

fields.name: model_name
fields.description: Name of the sentence-transformers model to use for SemanticSimilarityEvaluator. Only relevant when evaluator_type is 'semantic_similarity'.

fields.name: custom_evaluator
fields.description: Python dotted import path (Pydantic ImportString) to a custom evaluator callable. Required and validated non-null when evaluator_type is 'custom'. Resolved and validated at config parse time — import failure fails fast.

validators.expression: custom_evaluator is not None if evaluator_type == 'custom' else True
validators.error_message: custom_evaluator must be provided when evaluator_type is 'custom'

types.description: Per-task evaluator configuration. Frozen Pydantic model validated at config parse time. Determines which evaluator to use and provides evaluator-specific parameters. Config errors fail fast via Pydantic validation — never silently defaults.

types.name: FieldEvaluation

fields.name: field_name
fields.description: The name of the field that was evaluated.

fields.name: matched
fields.description: Whether the local value exactly matched the remote (ground truth) value for this field.

fields.name: local_value
fields.description: The value of this field in the local TaskResponse. May be None if the field was missing.

fields.name: remote_value
fields.description: The value of this field in the remote (ground truth) TaskResponse. May be None if the field was missing.

fields.name: similarity
fields.description: Optional similarity score for this field. Set to 1.0 if matched, 0.0 if not matched for exact-match fields. May carry cosine similarity if a hybrid evaluator is used. Null when not computed.

types.description: Per-field evaluation result for StructuredMatchEvaluator. Frozen Pydantic model capturing match status and both local/remote values for auditability. Serializable via .model_dump(mode='json').

types.name: EvaluationResult

fields.name: score
fields.description: Overall evaluation score, clamped to [0.0, 1.0]. 1.0 = perfect match, 0.0 = no match or error.

validators.error_message: score must be between 0.0 and 1.0 inclusive

fields.name: evaluator_type
fields.description: String identifier of the evaluator that produced this result (e.g. 'structured_match', 'exact_match', 'semantic_similarity', 'custom'). Used for log filtering and audit.

fields.name: field_breakdown
fields.description: Per-field evaluation breakdown. Keys are field names (str), values are FieldEvaluation instances. Empty dict for evaluators that do not operate on individual fields (ExactMatch, SemanticSimilarity).

fields.name: error
fields.description: Error message if the evaluation encountered a runtime error (field access failure, embedding model load failure, etc.). Null when evaluation succeeded normally. When set, score is typically 0.0.

fields.name: metadata
fields.description: Evaluator-specific metadata. For SemanticSimilarityEvaluator: {'model_name': str, 'raw_cosine_similarity': float}. For custom evaluators: whatever the custom function returns. Keys are strings, values are any JSON-serializable type.

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: ISO-8601 datetime string of when this evaluation was performed.

types.description: Frozen Pydantic model representing the outcome of a single evaluation. Immutable after creation. Score is always clamped to [0.0, 1.0]. Serializable via .model_dump(mode='json') for structured logging and JSON state persistence. evaluator_type enables log filtering and audit trail.

types.name: EmbedFunction
types.description: Type alias for a callable that takes a list of strings and returns a list of embedding vectors (list of list of floats). Signature: Callable[[list[str]], list[list[float]]]. Used for dependency injection in SemanticSimilarityEvaluator to avoid hard coupling to sentence-transformers.

types.name: EvaluatorProtocol

fields.name: evaluate
fields.description: Protocol method signature: evaluate(self, local: TaskResponse, remote: TaskResponse, task_config: TaskEvaluatorConfig) -> EvaluationResult. Structural typing — implementors need only match this signature.

types.description: typing.Protocol (runtime_checkable) defining the Evaluator interface. Any class with an 'evaluate' method matching the signature satisfies this protocol via structural typing — no inheritance required. Built-in implementations and FunctionEvaluatorAdapter all satisfy this protocol.

functions.name: StructuredMatchEvaluator.evaluate
functions.description: Evaluates local vs remote TaskResponse by comparing each field listed in task_config.match_fields using exact equality. Returns the average match rate across all configured fields as the score. Produces a per-field breakdown in field_breakdown. Missing fields in either response are treated as non-matching (matched=False). Score is clamped to [0.0, 1.0]. Stateless — no side effects beyond result construction.

inputs.name: local
inputs.description: The local model's response to evaluate.

inputs.name: remote
inputs.description: The remote (ground truth) response to compare against.

inputs.name: task_config
inputs.description: Task-specific evaluator config. match_fields must be non-empty.

error_cases.name: field_access_error
error_cases.condition: A field listed in match_fields is not present in local.fields or remote.fields, or field access raises an unexpected exception

error_data.behavior: Returns EvaluationResult with score=0.0, error message describing which field(s) were inaccessible. Does NOT raise an exception.

error_cases.name: empty_match_fields
error_cases.condition: task_config.match_fields is empty (should be caught at config parse time)

error_data.behavior: Pydantic validation error raised at config construction time, not at evaluate() call time. Fail-fast behavior.

preconditions: task_config.match_fields is non-empty (enforced by config validation)
local and remote have the same task_id
postconditions: result.score >= 0.0 and result.score <= 1.0
result.evaluator_type == 'structured_match'
result.field_breakdown contains exactly one entry per field in task_config.match_fields
result.score == average of (1.0 if matched else 0.0) across all fields in field_breakdown
result.error is None on success, non-None string on runtime field access errors
result.timestamp is a valid ISO-8601 datetime string

structured_side_effects.description: Stateless pure function. No I/O, no mutation, no logging.

functions.name: ExactMatchEvaluator.evaluate
functions.description: Evaluates local vs remote TaskResponse by comparing the full output strings for exact equality. Returns score 1.0 if local.output == remote.output, else 0.0. No per-field breakdown (field_breakdown is empty dict). Stateless — no side effects.

inputs.name: local
inputs.description: The local model's response to evaluate.

inputs.name: remote
inputs.description: The remote (ground truth) response to compare against.

inputs.name: task_config
inputs.description: Task-specific evaluator config. match_fields and model_name are ignored for this evaluator.

error_cases.name: output_access_error
error_cases.condition: Unexpected error accessing local.output or remote.output (should not occur with valid TaskResponse, but guarded defensively)

error_data.behavior: Returns EvaluationResult with score=0.0 and error message. Does NOT raise.

preconditions: local and remote have the same task_id
postconditions: result.score == 1.0 if local.output == remote.output else result.score == 0.0
result.evaluator_type == 'exact_match'
result.field_breakdown == {}
result.error is None
result.timestamp is a valid ISO-8601 datetime string

structured_side_effects.description: Stateless pure function. No I/O, no mutation.

functions.name: SemanticSimilarityEvaluator.__init__
functions.description: Constructs a SemanticSimilarityEvaluator. Accepts an optional embed_fn for dependency injection. If embed_fn is None, the evaluator will lazy-load a sentence-transformers model on first call to evaluate(). The model is NOT loaded at construction time — only when first needed. The instance is stateless aside from the cached embedding function/model reference.

inputs.name: embed_fn
inputs.description: Optional callable with signature (list[str]) -> list[list[float]]. If provided, used instead of loading sentence-transformers. Enables testing without ML dependencies and dependency injection per operating procedures.

preconditions: If embed_fn is provided, it must be callable and accept a list of strings returning a list of float vectors of equal length
postconditions: Instance is created with embed_fn stored (or None for lazy loading)
No model is loaded at construction time

structured_side_effects.description: No side effects at construction time. Model loading is deferred.

functions.name: SemanticSimilarityEvaluator.evaluate
functions.description: Evaluates local vs remote TaskResponse by computing cosine similarity of their output embeddings. Lazy-loads sentence-transformers model on first invocation if no embed_fn was injected. Cosine similarity is mapped via max(0.0, cosine_sim) — negative similarity maps to 0.0 (no match, not negative score). Score is clamped to [0.0, 1.0]. No per-field breakdown. Metadata includes model_name and raw_cosine_similarity.

inputs.name: local
inputs.description: The local model's response to evaluate.

inputs.name: remote
inputs.description: The remote (ground truth) response to compare against.

inputs.name: task_config
inputs.description: Task-specific evaluator config. model_name determines which sentence-transformers model to load (default 'all-MiniLM-L6-v2').

error_cases.name: embedding_model_load_failure
error_cases.condition: sentence-transformers is not installed or model specified by task_config.model_name cannot be loaded, and no embed_fn was injected

error_data.behavior: Returns EvaluationResult with score=0.0, error message describing the load failure, and metadata including attempted model_name. Does NOT raise.

error_cases.name: embedding_computation_error
error_cases.condition: embed_fn raises an exception during embedding computation (e.g. OOM, invalid input)

error_data.behavior: Returns EvaluationResult with score=0.0 and error message. Does NOT raise.

error_cases.name: empty_output
error_cases.condition: local.output or remote.output is an empty string

error_data.behavior: Returns EvaluationResult with score=0.0 and error message indicating empty output cannot be embedded. Does NOT raise.

preconditions: local and remote have the same task_id
local.output and remote.output are non-empty strings
postconditions: result.score >= 0.0 and result.score <= 1.0
result.evaluator_type == 'semantic_similarity'
result.field_breakdown == {}
result.metadata contains 'model_name' key with string value
result.metadata contains 'raw_cosine_similarity' key with float value
result.score == max(0.0, min(1.0, raw_cosine_similarity))
result.timestamp is a valid ISO-8601 datetime string
If error occurred, result.error is non-None and result.score == 0.0
side_effects: May lazy-load sentence-transformers model into memory on first call if no embed_fn was injected

structured_side_effects.description: Caches the loaded embedding model/function internally on first call for subsequent reuse. This is the only stateful behavior.

functions.name: FunctionEvaluatorAdapter.__init__
functions.description: Wraps a plain callable (resolved from a Python dotted import path via Pydantic ImportString) into an object satisfying the Evaluator protocol. The wrapped function must accept (local: TaskResponse, remote: TaskResponse, task_config: TaskEvaluatorConfig) and return either an EvaluationResult or a float score.

inputs.name: fn
inputs.description: The custom evaluator callable resolved from config. Must accept (TaskResponse, TaskResponse, TaskEvaluatorConfig) and return EvaluationResult or float.

error_data.behavior: Raises TypeError at construction time with clear message. Fail-fast behavior.

preconditions: fn accepts three positional arguments: local (TaskResponse), remote (TaskResponse), task_config (TaskEvaluatorConfig)
postconditions: Instance is created wrapping the provided callable
Instance satisfies the Evaluator protocol (has evaluate method with correct signature)

functions.name: FunctionEvaluatorAdapter.evaluate
functions.description: Delegates to the wrapped callable. If the callable returns a float, wraps it into an EvaluationResult with evaluator_type='custom', empty field_breakdown, and clamped score. If it returns an EvaluationResult, passes it through with score clamping applied. Any exception from the callable is caught and returned as an EvaluationResult with score=0.0 and error annotation.

inputs.name: local
inputs.description: The local model's response to evaluate.

inputs.name: remote
inputs.description: The remote (ground truth) response to compare against.

error_cases.name: custom_function_exception
error_cases.condition: The wrapped callable raises any exception during execution

error_data.behavior: Catches the exception. Returns EvaluationResult with score=0.0, evaluator_type='custom', error message containing exception details. Does NOT re-raise.

error_cases.name: invalid_return_type
error_cases.condition: The wrapped callable returns a value that is neither float, int, nor EvaluationResult

error_data.behavior: Returns EvaluationResult with score=0.0 and error message indicating unexpected return type. Does NOT raise.

preconditions: local and remote have the same task_id
postconditions: result.score >= 0.0 and result.score <= 1.0 (clamped)
result.evaluator_type == 'custom'
result.timestamp is a valid ISO-8601 datetime string
If wrapped callable raised, result.error is non-None and result.score == 0.0
side_effects: Delegates to user-provided callable which may have arbitrary side effects

structured_side_effects.description: The wrapped custom callable may have arbitrary side effects. The adapter itself is stateless.

functions.name: create_evaluator
functions.description: Factory function that creates the appropriate evaluator instance from a TaskEvaluatorConfig. Routes based on evaluator_type: 'structured_match' -> StructuredMatchEvaluator(), 'exact_match' -> ExactMatchEvaluator(), 'semantic_similarity' -> SemanticSimilarityEvaluator(embed_fn), 'custom' -> FunctionEvaluatorAdapter(resolved_callable). For custom evaluators, the import path in task_config.custom_evaluator is resolved at config parse time via Pydantic ImportString, so by the time this factory is called the callable is already validated and importable.

inputs.name: task_config
inputs.description: The task evaluator configuration specifying which evaluator to create.

inputs.name: embed_fn
inputs.description: Optional embedding function to inject into SemanticSimilarityEvaluator. If None, the evaluator will lazy-load sentence-transformers.

error_cases.name: unknown_evaluator_type
error_cases.condition: task_config.evaluator_type is not one of the known EvaluatorType variants (should not occur if config validation is correct)

error_data.behavior: Raises ValueError with message describing the unsupported evaluator type. Fail-fast.

error_cases.name: custom_import_failure
error_cases.condition: task_config.custom_evaluator dotted path cannot be resolved to a callable (should be caught at config parse time, but guarded here too)

error_data.behavior: Raises ImportError with clear message. Fail-fast at evaluator creation time.

preconditions: task_config is a valid TaskEvaluatorConfig (Pydantic validated)
If evaluator_type is 'custom', task_config.custom_evaluator is a non-None importable dotted path
postconditions: Returned object satisfies the Evaluator protocol (has evaluate method with correct signature)
Returned evaluator type matches task_config.evaluator_type

structured_side_effects.description: Pure factory function. No I/O, no state mutation.

functions.name: clamp_score
functions.description: Utility function that clamps a raw score to the [0.0, 1.0] range. Used as a post-computation safety net by all evaluators. Applies min(1.0, max(0.0, score)). This is a pure function with no side effects.

error_data.behavior: Raises ValueError indicating NaN is not a valid score. Fail-fast — NaN should never silently become 0.0.

preconditions: score is a finite float (not NaN, not inf)
postconditions: result >= 0.0 and result <= 1.0
if score < 0.0 then result == 0.0
if score > 1.0 then result == 1.0
if 0.0 <= score <= 1.0 then result == score

functions.name: cosine_similarity
functions.description: Computes cosine similarity between two embedding vectors. Returns a float in [-1.0, 1.0]. Used internally by SemanticSimilarityEvaluator. Pure function, no dependencies beyond stdlib math.

inputs.name: vec_a
inputs.description: First embedding vector as a list of floats.

inputs.name: vec_b
inputs.description: Second embedding vector as a list of floats.

error_data.behavior: Raises ValueError indicating vectors must have the same dimensionality.

error_cases.name: empty_vectors
error_cases.condition: vec_a or vec_b is an empty list

error_data.behavior: Raises ValueError indicating embedding vectors must be non-empty.

preconditions: vec_a and vec_b are non-empty lists of floats
vec_a and vec_b have the same length
At least one of vec_a, vec_b has non-zero magnitude
postconditions: result >= -1.0 and result <= 1.0
If both vectors are identical, result == 1.0
If either vector has zero magnitude, result == 0.0

invariants: All evaluator implementations satisfy the Evaluator protocol via structural typing (runtime_checkable) — no inheritance required
All EvaluationResult.score values are in [0.0, 1.0] — enforced by clamp_score post-computation and Pydantic field validator

All evaluators are stateless with respect to evaluation logic — evaluate() calls with the same inputs always produce the same score (deterministic for StructuredMatch and ExactMatch; SemanticSimilarity is deterministic given the same model and embed_fn)
Runtime errors in evaluate() never raise exceptions — they return EvaluationResult with score=0.0 and error annotation

Config validation errors (invalid evaluator_type, empty match_fields for structured_match, missing custom_evaluator for custom) fail fast at config parse time via Pydantic validation, never at runtime
Custom evaluator import paths are resolved and validated at config parse time (Pydantic ImportString) — import failures are startup errors, not runtime errors
SemanticSimilarityEvaluator lazy-loads the sentence-transformers model only on first evaluate() call, not at construction time
Negative cosine similarity values are mapped to 0.0 — the score domain is [0.0, 1.0], not [-1.0, 1.0]
All EvaluationResult instances are frozen Pydantic models — immutable after creation
All EvaluationResult instances are JSON-serializable via .model_dump(mode='json') for structured logging and state persistence
No global state — all configuration flows through TaskEvaluatorConfig, all dependencies flow through constructor injection
FunctionEvaluatorAdapter wraps the return value of custom callables: float -> EvaluationResult with clamped score; EvaluationResult -> pass-through with clamped score; other -> error result
